items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: Then they had this other boy, Eddie Atkins was in there.

ctx.x: I remember one picture they had Zoo Robertson, do you remember Zoo?

Yeah, Zoo was there at one time. He was there at one time? Yeah, yeah, that's right. He's dead now. Then they had this other boy, Eddie Atkins was in there. And, uh, well, it's hard to say because, I mean, we've changed the trombone. He changed the trombone.
